people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
translations.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
